blurb: An adapter wraps foreign code, so it holds only what describes that boundary: capabilities, the types that cross it, external providers and helper functions. A `service`, an `agent` or an `actor` has behaviour, state and an address of its own, and those belong to a context. Move the item into a context that `consumes` the adapter's capability, and leave the adapter as an interface to the foreign code.
summary: An `adapter` declared a `service`, `agent`, or other item it may not contain.
